name: Sotsugyou 3 ~Wedding Bell~
source:
The game begins with the teacher, who is the player married with one of his students. The principal finds out and asks the student to be expelled from the school. The teacher makes a deal with the principal that this secret life with his students will not be revealed to the public and he also promises that he will coach his students all the way to an A when they graduate.

[from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=234&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
游戏开始时，玩家扮演的教师已经与自己的一名学生结婚。校长发现后，要求开除那名学生。教师与校长达成交易：不将他与学生的秘密生活公之于众；作为交换，他承诺会一直辅导学生们，直到她们毕业并取得A等级。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=234&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
